title: emergency.py: Missing type validation on ts and timeout_s allows type confusion
description:
Lines 195-196: data.get('ts', ...) and data.get('timeout_s', ...) accept arbitrary CBOR types without validation. If attacker provides a string, dict, or list, it is stored directly. Downstream code expecting numeric values will crash or behave unexpectedly. SosResource validates its timestamp (lines 133-139) but RollcallResource does not.
